verdict.rationale: skills.sh installs skills into each agent's native skills directories, at project or global scope. The Agent Skills spec it builds on says agents load each skill's name and description at startup to judge when it is relevant, which enables context-based auto-activation. That triggering is done by the host agent under the spec, though, not by skills.sh. skills.sh's only description-related tooling is a SKILL.md template generator (`skills init`), plus the spec's `skills-ref validate` command. Missing for 10: guidance or tooling for engineering descriptions so the right skill triggers, first-party docs on activation behavior after install, and hands-on corroboration that installed skills trigger reliably.
